````markdown
## Description
Used in [Modify Global Variable](/wiki/articles/modify+global+variable), [Modify Player Variable](/wiki/articles/modify+player+variable), [Modify Global Variable At Index](/wiki/articles/modify+global+variable+at+index) and [Modify Player Variable At Index](/wiki/articles/modify+player+variable+at+index). The way in which the variable's value will be changed. Options include standard arithmetic operations as well as array operations for appending and removing values.

## Options
- **Add** 
- **Append To Array** 
- **Divide** 
- **Max** 
- **Min** 
- **Modulo** 
- **Multiply** 
- **Raise To Power** 
- **Remove From Array By Index** 
- **Remove From Array By Value** 
- **Subtract** 
````
